newsitem.title: FINLAND: RESEARCH ALERT - CSFB KEEPS BUY ON RAISIO.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CSFB KEEPS BUY ON RAISIO.

text.p: CS First Boston is keeping its buy recommendation on Finnish food and feed group Raision Tehtaat Oy and sees the group finding a partner in the first half of 1997, it said in a research note received on Monday.

"The confirmation that negotiations are at least taking place would indicate that a recognised food name should soon (H1 in our assumptions) be associated with Raisio," CSFB said in the research report dated January 15.
CSFB referred to confirmation from Raisio that talks were under way after the International Herald Tribune said Raisio had been besieged with partnership offers from leading food groups.

"This should greatly enhance Raisio's credibility," CSFB said. It added it expected 1997 to bring more news from Raisio on its cholesterol-reducing Benecol margarine, including on raw material supply and esterification capacity.
"So far the news confirms the assumptions supporting our discounted cash flow valuation of $2.5 billion for Benecol -- a share-price equivalent of about 900 markka," it said.
Its target 12-month share price for Raisio is 450 markka, it said. On the Helsinki Stock Exchange at 1210/1010 GMT on Monday, Raisio was up 3.00 at 382.00.
CSFB said it expects Raisio's earnings per share to rise to 11.7 markka in 1997 and to 39.8 markka in 1998 -- up from an estimated 5.2 markka in 1996.
